item.title: Iran-linked hackers target US medical tech company
item.summary: Iran-linked hackers allegedly targeted the Stryker medical company, wiping devices through Microsoft systems. Learn how this cyberattack affects you.

item.title: Critical swing state candidates reveal where they stand on DHS funding after suspected terror attacks
item.summary: Four suspected terror attacks hit the US during DHS shutdown as Michigan Senate candidates split on funding with Republican Mike Rogers supporting reopening the department.

item.title: Iranian drone attacks strain US air defenses as Ukraine pitches low-cost interceptors
item.summary: The rapid spread of low-cost Iranian Shahed drones is forcing the U.S. and its allies to use expensive missile defenses to counter mass attacks.

item.title: Video allegedly shows Michigan synagogue attacker buying $2K in fireworks days before truck rampage
item.summary: Ayman Mohamad Ghazali allegedly purchased $2,250 worth of fireworks before ramming a truck into Temple Israel synagogue in West Bloomfield, Michigan.

item.title: BROADCAST BIAS: Networks hide the ‘M’ word after Muslim terror attack
item.summary: ABC, NBC, CBS avoided identifying Muslim terror suspects in New York bomb plot while labeling another group merely as 'far-right anti-immigrant.'

item.title: Pennsylvania men accused of ISIS-inspired bomb attack on NYC protesters near mayor's mansion: timeline
item.summary: Two Pennsylvania men accused of ISIS-inspired terror plot threw homemade bombs at NYC protesters. Both explosive devices failed to detonate during the incident.

item.title: Travel agencies warn spring break tourists about Mexico safety risks after recent surge of cartel violence
item.summary: Travel agencies advise heightened caution for Mexico trips as cartel conflicts created temporary violence spikes in popular resort regions last month, with safety varying significantly by state.

item.title: Man accused of attacking TSA officers, seriously injuring Dallas cop at airport
item.summary: A California man faces 20 years in prison after allegedly assaulting TSA officers and injuring a Dallas police officer at Love Field Airport in a violent incident.

item.title: JONATHAN TURLEY: How Gov Shapiro became a squatter and got sued by his neighbors
item.summary: Pennsylvania governor Josh Shapiro faces lawsuit from neighbors alleging he used state police to seize land for an 8-foot security fence around his home.

item.title: Ex-NFL star predicts streaming giants will team up for bundles as league rights become 'so damn expensive'
item.summary: NFL media rights deal could force streaming services to bundle together as costs expected to soar beyond $10 billion annually, said former Pro Bowler Shawne Merriman.
